name: roomly-monorepo
description: Roomly — Luxury Hotel Booking and Operations Platform

scripts.dev: concurrently -n "API,WEB" -c "blue,magenta" "npm --prefix apps/api run dev" "npm --prefix apps/web run dev"
scripts.build: npm --prefix apps/api run build && npm --prefix apps/web run build
scripts.test: npm --prefix apps/api test && npm --prefix apps/web test
